target.statement: IDA-VLM achieves 0.716 accuracy on the Matching sub-task of the MM-ID benchmark, outperforming GPT-4V (0.627) and Gemini-pro (0.687).

compute.basis: Training IDA-VLM requires 8×A100-SXM-80GB GPUs for approximately 1 day per stage (2 stages total), plus data construction and evaluation; the model is 9.6B parameters and cannot be trained on a CPU within a few hours.

blockers: Requires 8×A100-SXM-80GB GPUs for training (1 day per stage, 2 stages)
MM-ID benchmark data may not be fully public (only URLs for animation images are provided; MovieNet and Re-ID datasets have their own access restrictions)
Second-stage tuning data was generated using GPT-4V, which is a closed-source API and may not be reproducible
Evaluation of Q&A and Caption sub-tasks relies on GPT-4 scoring, which is a closed-source API
title: IDA-VLM: Towards Movie Understanding via ID-Aware Large Vision-Language Model
